The *Sumaṅgalattheraapadāna* (Tha Ap 114) is a verse text included in the Therāpadāna section of the Pali Khuddaka Nikāya [SuttaCentral]. It preserves the biographical account (*apadāna*) of the elder Sumaṅgala. Translations of the text are cataloged in five languages on SuttaCentral [SuttaCentral].
No external parallels in Sanskrit, Chinese, or Tibetan are recorded for this text [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. However, automated text-reuse analysis by DharmaNexus shows substantial reuse within Pali literature, most prominently with the Theragāthā commentary (*Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā*, Paṭhamo bhāgo), sharing 15 matches totaling over 2,000 characters, including a continuous alignment spanning §1.2–9.3 of the *apadāna* with commentary segments §1211–1227 [DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus also detects smaller shared passages with the second part of the *Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā*, the *Āṭānāṭiya Sutta* (DN 32), and fellow apadāna poems including the *Paccupaṭṭhānasaññakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 121) and the *Suvaṇṇapupphiyattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 117) [DharmaNexus].
